facts.business: BF Utilities Limited generates wind power and holds investments in infrastructure subsidiaries.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company is taking all efforts to improve wind power generation, reduce cost and improve realization.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Adverse opinion on consolidated financial statements due to inability to obtain information from component auditors of three subsidiaries (NHDL, NICE, NECE) and possible effects on group functioning; Adverse opinion on internal financial controls over consolidated financial statements.

key_risks: Highly regulated environment; changes in government policies may adversely affect operations.
Dependence on service provider for O&M of wind turbines; pending litigations with earlier service providers.
Single customer for sale of power.
Arbitration notice from investors of step-down subsidiary NECE alleging failure to provide exit.
facts.related_party_note: No funds advanced/loaned/invested to intermediaries for benefit of ultimate beneficiaries; no funds received from funding parties for such purposes (Notes 36a and 36b).
